Property Description

Located in the quiet area of Pererenan, this lovely three-bedroom villa offers comfortable tropical living. The villa is close to cafes, restaurants, and the beach, making it a great place to enjoy Bali.

The villa features an open living area and comes fully furnished, so it is ready to move in. With three ensuite bedrooms and communal parking within a one-gate community, it is ideal for long-term stays.

  • This villa has three spacious bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom.
  • The open living, dining, and kitchen area provides a bright and comfortable space for everyday living.
  • Fully furnished and move-in ready, the villa offers everything you need for a comfortable stay.
  • Located in a peaceful yet convenient area of Pererenan, the villa is just a short drive from the beach, cafes, and other popular spots.

Rental             : Yearly.

Furniture         : Fully Furnished.

Price               : IDR 365,000,000/year
